Schedule I Condensed Balance Sheets (parent company only, Dec. 31, 2016 | Dec. 31, 2015): "Total UnitedHealth Group shareholders’ equity | 38,274 | 33,830" ($ in millions). The consolidated BS prints only "Total equity" incl. nonredeemable NCI; the parent figure ties exactly to the consolidated BS of the same filing (33,725 + 105 (NCI deficit) = 33,830) and to the sum of common stock + APIC + retained earnings + AOCI on the consolidated BS. Under equity-method parent accounting this is the consolidated parent equity, printed (not derived as total minus NCI).
rule_proposal: Serve stockholders_equity from the Schedule I parent-company line when the consolidated face prints only total equity incl. NCI and the Schedule I figure ties exactly to consolidated total equity minus nonredeemable NCI (element StockholdersEquity, ParentCompanyMember).
